checkpointed_restarts.reason: Resume at the same pin with zero-coverage features first in repair.
Retry the three unresolved features first within the same cumulative cap.

native_execution.call_count_interpretation: Counts and token totals cover completed trace records. Interrupted generation attempts listed in the restart receipts have unreported usage.

budget.interpretation: Native subscription clients report no invoiced USD cost. This is the checkpoint budget ledger with a fixed USD 0.50 review reservation per call, not a measured invoice or proof that actual billing is capped.

limitations: Every inventoried feature was considered; unsupported facets remain explicit.
Source slices are bounded. Static representative traces are not runtime coverage.
Breadth includes feature summaries and checked interface records; it is distinct from semantic depth.
Maintainer notes are partial and historical. Current behavior is checked against the source pin.
Validation facets describe existing test assertions; upstream JiuwenSwarm tests were not executed here.
Generator served identity is reported; the Codex client does not report served-model identity.
